summary: Iteration 37: Card Analytics and Chat Modernization - All 17 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend UI verified: Analytics page shows overview stats, daily views chart, device breakdown, traffic sources. Chat page has profile hyperlinks on avatars and names. Feed sidebar has Analytics link and suggested users with profile links. PostCard @mentions and #hashtags are clickable links.
critical_code_review_comments: Card Analytics router (/api/analytics/) correctly implements view tracking, card detail, and overview endpoints
ViewCardPage.jsx tracks card view on load via POST /api/analytics/cards/{cardId}/view
CardAnalyticsPage.jsx shows overview stats, daily views bar chart, cards list, device breakdown, traffic sources, and recent viewers
ChatPage.jsx has <Link> components wrapping user avatars and names in chat list and chat header
Chat list profile links use data-testid='chat-list-profile-link'
Chat header profile link uses data-testid='chat-profile-link'
PostCard.jsx RenderContent parses @username into clickable links to /profile/{username}
PostCard.jsx RenderContent parses #hashtag into clickable links to /hashtag/{tag}
FeedPage.jsx sidebar shows Analytics link at /analytics when user is logged in
FeedPage.jsx sidebar shows suggested users with clickable profile links
Chat empty state shows 'Tus Mensajes' with tilted send icon as designed
Chat search filter works to filter conversations by name
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 37 verified Card Analytics and Chat Modernization features. Key findings: 1) Analytics endpoints at /api/analytics/cards/{id}/view (track), /api/analytics/cards/{id} (detail), /api/analytics/overview work correctly. 2) CardAnalyticsPage at /analytics shows overview stats, daily views chart, cards list with click-to-detail. 3) ChatPage has profile hyperlinks on avatars and names in both chat list and chat header. 4) PostCard @mentions link to /profile/{username}, #hashtags link to /hashtag/{tag}. 5) Feed sidebar shows Analytics link and suggested users with profile links when logged in. Key data-testids: card-analytics-page, analytics-bar-chart, analytics-card-{id}, chat-page, chat-list-profile-link, chat-profile-link, chat-search-input, new-chat-btn, chat-input, send-message-btn, start-video-call-btn, start-audio-call-btn, hashtag-{tag}, mention-{username}, feed-sidebar, suggested-user-{id}.

card_analytics_track_view.details: Tracks view with/without auth, captures device type and source URL

chat_profile_links_list.details: Chat list avatars and names are wrapped in <Link> to /profile/{userId}

chat_profile_links_header.details: Chat header avatar and name link to /profile/{participantId}

chat_modern_ui.details: Rounded search input, clean message bubbles, backdrop blur header, video/audio call buttons

chat_empty_state.details: Shows 'Tus Mensajes' with tilted send icon and 'Nueva Conversacion' button

chat_search_filter.details: Search input filters conversations by name

feed_sidebar_analytics.details: Sidebar shows Analytics link at /analytics when logged in

feed_sidebar_suggested_users.details: Sidebar shows suggested users with clickable profile links

hashtag_page.details: HashtagPage shows posts filtered by hashtag with related hashtags
